subject: general
question:
What would be the number on the opposite side of '7' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6f34048fc1c483485a250b8ab176448d9a7c0ea74a9c002c048643bf35cf8d4.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63c219b234e065d3f9686cd0c9bbf95471473b89d4927d8e6c6dfe933d811e7a.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

5 → 8

10 → 6

7 → 9

Therefore, '9' is the opposite of '7'.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
